newsitem.title: UK: ICI RAISES $1.5 BILLION VIA THREE FRNS.
newsitem.headline: ICI RAISES $1.5 BILLION VIA THREE FRNS.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc has launched three short-dated FRNs worth a total $1.5 billion, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Wednesday.
The three $500 million deals are due September 1998, December 1998 and March 1999 respectively. Each pays three-month LIBOR plus 6.25 basis points.
The two latter deals are callable at par in September 1998.
The March 1999 deal is also callable at par in December 1998.
The payment date is September 5. Fees total 0.05 point.
The deals are launched off ICI's $4 billion EMTN programme rated Baa1/A-.
